gamingOptimizations.name: CPU Core Unparking (100% Core Availability)
gamingOptimizations.descriptionSimple: Forces all CPU cores to stay awake instead of sleeping during games. Eliminates sudden stutter.
gamingOptimizations.descriptionTech: Unhides CPMINCORES power attribute and sets minimum unparked cores to 100% across AC/DC.
gamingOptimizations.gamingImpact: Reduces 1% low frame time spikes and micro-stutters in CPU-intensive titles.

gamingOptimizations.name: Activate Ultimate Performance Power Scheme
gamingOptimizations.descriptionSimple: Activates Windows' hidden high-speed power plan that keeps CPU clocks at maximum frequency.
gamingOptimizations.descriptionTech: Duplicates scheme e9a42b02-d5df-448d-aa00-03f14749eb61 and sets as active power profile.
gamingOptimizations.gamingImpact: Eliminates clock speed ramp-up delays when heavy action occurs in-game.

gamingOptimizations.name: Force Windows Game Mode ON
gamingOptimizations.descriptionSimple: Tells Windows to prioritize CPU/GPU resources and pause background Windows updates during games.
gamingOptimizations.gamingImpact: Prevents Windows Update from initiating reboots or installations while gaming.

gamingOptimizations.name: Enable Hardware-Accelerated GPU Scheduling (HAGS)
gamingOptimizations.descriptionSimple: Lets your graphics card manage its own memory scheduling directly instead of the CPU.
gamingOptimizations.gamingImpact: Reduces input latency and unlocks Frame Generation on RTX 40/50 series GPUs.

gamingOptimizations.name: Disable Windows Game DVR / Background Recording
gamingOptimizations.descriptionSimple: Stops Windows from constantly recording your gameplay to disk in the background.
gamingOptimizations.descriptionTech: Sets HKCU:\System\GameConfigStore GameDVR_Enabled = 0 and Policies GameDVR AllowGameDVR = 0
gamingOptimizations.gamingImpact: Frees 3-5% GPU encoding overhead and saves continuous SSD write cycles.

gamingOptimizations.name: Optimize MMCSS Games GPU Scheduler Priority
gamingOptimizations.descriptionSimple: Tells the multimedia scheduler to give maximum priority to game threads.
gamingOptimizations.descriptionTech: Sets HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile\Tasks\Games GPU Priority = 8, Priority = 6, Scheduling Category = High
gamingOptimizations.gamingImpact: Stabilizes frame delivery when running discord or streaming tools concurrently.

gamingOptimizations.name: Disable Network Throttling Index
gamingOptimizations.descriptionSimple: Removes Windows' built-in 10-packet-per-millisecond network throttle on multimedia apps.
gamingOptimizations.gamingImpact: Lowers ping spikes and jitter in online competitive multiplayer.

gamingOptimizations.name: Optimize SvcHost Process Memory Threshold
gamingOptimizations.descriptionSimple: Optimizes system background process pooling according to your physical RAM size.
gamingOptimizations.descriptionTech: Sets HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control SvcHostSplitThresholdInKB based on system RAM.
gamingOptimizations.gamingImpact: Reduces total svchost count on low-RAM systems or isolates processes on 32GB+ systems.
